Created scripts/create-cluster-vms.sh; full and per-role dry-runs verified; bash 3.2 empty-arg path safe
Defaulted guest to rhel9_64Guest and HW version to 19; verified govc -version=19 yields vmx-19 via throwaway VM

Merged in PR #5. Cluster default set on ocs-storagecluster-ceph-rbd, virt default on ocs-storagecluster-ceph-rbd-virtualization, via partial server-side apply with Prune=false,Delete=false. Verified with SSA dry-run against the live cluster.

Verified working on hub 2026-07-28: hub-olm-external-secrets and hub-cfg-external-secrets both Synced/Healthy, CSV openshift-external-secrets-operator.v1.2.0 Succeeded, operand pods (controller, cert-controller, webhook) Running in the operator-created external-secrets namespace, token secret present, and ClusterSecretStore 1password-sdk reports Ready=True reason=Valid.

Fixed in PR #8. Install modes now read from the channel subscription.yaml pins, not channels[0] — stricter than defaultChannel and matching what OLM resolves against. Catalog scan confirmed the bug was capable of inverting the answer (kubearmor-operator-certified: channels[0]=alpha AllNamespaces vs default=stable OwnNamespace,SingleNamespace). Also split OwnNamespace from SingleNamespace for cross-namespace OperatorGroups, and separated CHANNEL NOT FOUND from NOT IN CATALOG. Verified by reintroducing both bug classes.

Merged in PR #11. components/ -> manifests/; components/ reserved with a README covering Component vs Kustomization, the two usage rules, conversion candidates, and what Components cannot fix. Verified 19/20 renders byte-identical, clusters/hub differs only in the 13 path values, element names unchanged so no Application renamed.

Merged in PR #13. Operator on stable-v1 in cert-manager-operator; CertManager CR deploys the operand; selfsigned-bootstrap -> homelab-ca Certificate -> homelab-ca ClusterIssuer; wildcard for *.apps.hub.lab.bewley.net wired into IngressController/default via partial SSA at sync wave 20. Private CA chosen because bewley.net runs self-hosted nameservers; Lets Encrypt over DNS-01/RFC2136 remains open as a second ClusterIssuer.

Merged in PR #14. rhbk-operator on stable-v26.6 in the keycloak namespace (targetNamespaces, OwnNamespace/SingleNamespace only); cloudnative-pg on stable-v1 in cnpg-system (AllNamespaces, so it can manage the Cluster in keycloak). Keycloak CR wired to the keycloak-db-rw Service and CNPG-generated keycloak-db-app secret; passthrough Route with keycloak-tls from homelab-ca; hostname keycloak.apps.hub.lab.bewley.net set in the overlay because it becomes the OIDC issuer URL.

Merged in PR #15. Vetted the ovn-recon additions: fixed the OperatorGroup's missing namespace (verified it was landing in the ambient namespace, demo-mirror locally), removed startingCSV v0.1.5 per user, corrected a copy-pasted nmstate comment and a hand-written OLM label with the wrong namespace, renamed the OperatorGroup to repo convention. Split the CatalogSource into manifests/olm/bewley-catalog so it is not pruned with any one operator. Collector stays disabled in base, hub opts in. Both layers plus the catalog wired into the hub ApplicationSets. AllNamespaces confirmed supported and correct. Component README added and manifests/README.md brought up to date.

Merged in PR #12. scripts/README.md now covers all six scripts plus allowed-orphans.txt, grouped by what each needs — day-0 vSphere provisioning, day-2 cluster validation, and repo validation that needs no cluster and therefore runs in CI. Left in_progress by oversight at the time.

Merged in PRs #16, #17 and #18. homelab realm with ocp-hub client, cluster-admins and developers groups, dlbewley plus five test accounts, secrets via placeholders from 1Password. Fixed the onepasswordSDK remoteRef format (item/field, not key+property) and added ignoreDifferences for ESO server-side defaults so the app reports Synced.
